name: yf_options_expiries
description:
Listed option expiration dates for one underlying from Yahoo Finance (yfinance options).
Returns: {symbol, expiries: ["YYYY-MM-DD", ...]} nearest first; an empty list when the symbol has no listed options.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Pass one of the dates to yf_options_chain as expiry. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "SPY"}
